performance.median_definition: For each input and batch size, take the median of each method's 3 recorded repetition times, then divide method medians. A cold repetition time is setup+sampling; its median need not equal median(setup)+median(sampling). Aggregate statistics are unweighted medians/minima/maxima of these per-case/per-batch ratios.

quality.scope: Specified zero-mean Gaussian threshold target. Marginal witnesses can reject full-law closeness but cannot accept it. Statistical bounds assume iid attempts and accurate floating-point target probabilities.
quality.bounds_interpretation: Witness values are LOWER bounds on full-law TV, not TV estimates or acceptance certificates. Complete numerical TV and conservative upper bounds are separate fields. Click means are descriptive and never share an error axis.

supplementary_small_laws.design: Supplementary deterministic complete-law quality review added after the performance configuration was frozen; all four predeclared small Frugal timing inputs are included, without new input generation or favorable-case selection.
supplementary_small_laws.scope: Full numerical P and induced Q on 8/12-mode synthetic threshold targets; not an extension of the primary quality confidence family or a claim about large Jiuzhang instances.
supplementary_small_laws.law_semantics: Complete conditional-chain laws under ideal continuous uniforms, including actual computed threshold saturation where applicable; not finite-PRNG-state enumeration.
